blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Champi, internationally known by its name, strengthened into a typhoon early Saturday morning, October 17. The state weather bureau said the typhoon is expected to bring rains to the country by Monday. In its 2 a.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Champi developed into a typhoon outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR).
